Resistances (info)

Features

  • Opportunity Attack

    Attack an enemy moving out of reach.

  • Permanently Armed

    Cannot be disarmed.

  • Magic Resistance

    Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

  • Nature's Step

    Alter the terrain around you, allowing nearby allies in the area to travel with ease.

    You and your allies within 4 m / 13 ft of range aren't affected by  Difficult Terrain, can't be  Restrained or  Paralysed, and gain Resistance to ⁠Poison damage.

  • Grasp of the Forest

    Weapon attacks can  Entangle the target.

The Dryad is a Fey creature that can be summoned through the spell  Conjure Woodland Being, a level four spell available to level 7 Druids. They channel powerful druidic powers, allowing them to entangle their enemies and call forth Wood Woads for help.

Combat

Attacks and actions

 Strengthened Shillelagh ()

Your staff or club becomes magical: it deals 4d8Bludgeoning damage, and uses your Spellcasting Ability for Attack rolls.

 Range: Self
 Entangle ()

Create a vine surface, slowing down creatures, possibly  Entangling them.

 STR Save
 Range: 18 m (60 ft)
 Fallen Lover ()

Summon a Wood Woad bound to your tree to fight alongside you.

 Range: 9 m (30 ft)
 Recharge: Short rest
 Spike Growth ()
Damage: 2~8
2d4⁠Piercing
Shape a piece of ground into hard spikes. A creature walking on the spikes takes 2d4⁠⁠Piercing damage for every 1.5 m (5 ft) it moves.

The spikes are Difficult Terrain, halving a creature's Movement Speed.

 Range: 18 m (60 ft)
